notes: Citywide cultural statement, 413 PDF pages (printed page = PDF page - 4). No appendix inventory; the yield is the narrative, the evaluation framework's worked examples (ch. 5) and the recommendations chapter's three lists (ch. 6): the three existing LGBTQ city landmarks, ~60 properties named as potentially eligible, and ~20 existing landmarks whose designation could be expanded. Buildings the statement itself marks not extant or demolished are not here, except 330 Grove Street and 399 4th Street, whose SITES the statement names as potentially significant for subsurface material. People: businesses, organisations, clinics, churches and venues are recorded freely; residences only where the statement treats the occupant as a public figure in this history and the residence is what makes the building significant. Passages naming private individuals as defendants, arrestees or victims of crime are excluded at extraction.
